results.title: Chennai financial influencer ends life amid cyberbullying allegations, YouTuber booked
results.description: Financial content creator V Harish, known as Finance With Harish, died by suicide near Chennai following alleged online harassment over his investment advisory credentials. Police are investigating his father’s complaint against YouTuber Jason Samuel and examining digital evidence Chennai: A 27-year-old financial content creator died by suicide at a rented villa near Muttukadu in Chennai …
